method: 2D projected vs 3D full J2000 propagation (30 days, 3-body)
key_finding: Moon z-component reaches ~40,000 km over 30 days, corresponding to its 5.1° inclination. 2D projection suppresses this, causing systematic position differences of similar magnitude. The heliocentric Earth-track difference between 2D and 3D stays modest over 30 days, while the lunar z excursion remains tens of thousands of kilometers. Full 3D extension would enable more accurate lunar swingby geometry but does not change the qualitative mission design conclusions.
note: This is a diagnostic comparison. The main project result uses the 2D ecliptic projection per course specification.
